text:
alvin: quick heads-up  we received 10 units for EU-edge pool, intake found 3 DOA. Vendor says replacements dispatched but currently held at FRA customs for valuation docs.
ops-bot: cluster-alert: eu-edge-pool node-count down 3, tail-p99 latency +18%.
sam: Any AWBs / manifest so we can push docs? We need ETA.
freightco: (vendor) AWB TL202400111 on hold. Customs requested detailed supplier invoice and proof of value. We pinged the shipper and insurance broker at 2024-04-11 08:42.
leo: If customs drags, we should consider swap from our NL depot loaner pool to avoid service impact. How long would inland reroute take? Cost?
freightco: Inland reroute to AMS depot: +10-14h, handling $200/unit. Air expedited clearance possible (~5-7h) but at +$950/unit.
alvin: These were earmarked for reserved enterprise commit for EU customers. Finance already flagged this batch. If we do inland reroute we still face a 12h delay to shift capacity.
sam: Recommendation: expedite air for 2 units (critical canaries), move 1 unit from NL loaners to EU region, and route remaining 1 replacement via AMS inland. That keeps canary health and limits uplift.
leo: I'll prepare NL loaner release. Need serial mapping and RMA tags. Can infra-proc approve ~$1.9k uplift for air?
alvin: Approving conditional on receipts. Route costs to infra-proc, note margin for insurance claim.
freightco: We can pre-send supplier invoice + commercial invoice to FRA agent. Need signed supplier invoice PDF and HS codes from you.
sam: Uploading serial -> cluster sheet: https://redwood.internal/serials/eu-topoff (internal). RMA IDs allocated: RMA-EU-20240411-01..03.
leo: ops: I'll flip node taints and add autoscaler buffer +8% now. If queue pressure persists >30% for 90m i'll escalate to oncall.
ops-bot: note: escalation rule armed for eu-edge-pool.
freightco: Docs received from shipper. Agent confirmed acceptance, customs release estimated in ~3h. Will post AWB clear when out.
alvin: Also log this as potential insurance claim — if any further damage found on depot intake we may request value recovery. FreightCo, please confirm whether we should open a claim now or wait for manifest release.
freightco: We recommend waiting for customs release and depot inspection, then file claim. If DOA verified, insurer typically needs photos + depot inspection report within 48h.
sam: noted. keeping thread for updates, thanks. :white_check_mark:
